meta.name: seo
meta.description: Optimize for search engine visibility and ranking. Use when asked to "improve SEO", "optimize for search", "fix meta tags", "add structured data", "sitemap optimization", or "search engine optimization".

copy.tagline: 提升网站在搜索引擎中的排名和可见度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让网站更容易被搜索引擎找到和收录
copy.tagline_en: Improve your website's search engine ranking and visibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website easier to find and index by search engines

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会帮你优化网页的搜索引擎可见性，包括修复 meta 标签、添加结构化数据、生成 sitemap、改善 URL 结构等。
howto.when: 当你要求“改善 SEO”、“优化搜索”、“修复 meta 标签”、“添加结构化数据”或“sitemap 优化”时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个页面的 SEO，包括标题和描述。
为我的产品页面添加结构化数据（JSON-LD）。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Product 类型的结构化数据。

say.text: 检查并修复 robots.txt 和 sitemap。

howto.what_en: Claude helps optimize web pages for search engine visibility, including fixing meta tags, adding structured data, generating sitemaps, and improving URL structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "improve SEO", "optimize for search", "fix meta tags", "add structured data", or "sitemap optimization".

say_en.text: Optimize this page's SEO, including title and description.
say_en.note: Claude will generate optimized title and meta description.

say_en.text: Add structured data (JSON-LD) for my product page.
Check and fix robots.txt and sitemap.
